Name: Farmer Portraits for Split-screen Co-op - Nyapu's Style
Author: kindtoeverykind
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/q86qPwT.png[/img][/center]
ATTENTION: This mod does not include the image assets. It only contains the code, which must be manually installed. See the Installation section below for details. SIDE NOTE: I am working on a content pack that will allow split-screen players to automatically change their Fashion Sense﻿ outfits in order for the sprites to match this mod's portraits (you can track my profile if you would like to receive a notification when it's uploaded). Until then, if players want their sprites to match their portraits, then they will have to change their clothes manually (either using in-game clothes or the Fashion Sense﻿ mirror).

An edit of the code in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29697]Farmer Portraits - Nyapu's Style[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/142995153]Jupm[/url] (which I highly recommend using for single-player and online multiplayer games), this is a content pack designed for split-screen co-op users utilizing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] as a framework.

The pack is designed for two split-screen players to be able to each have their own Nyapu-style portraits displayed that will automatically change based on certain game conditions like season, weather, location, and special occasions. Includes the option to have "reactions" to NPC dialogue as well (enable the "Use Emotions" configs).

Installation requires you to replace as well as edit some files. (The file edits are needed because this mod relies on PlayerName(s) for its targeting.) I am going to walk you through the steps here. Please still read the rest of the description sections below this one, as they also contain important information.

This may seem like a lot of steps for installation, so I am breaking it down into five small parts:

Part One:
[list=1]
[*]Download this mod and its requirements, which are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29697]Farmer Portraits - Nyapu's Style[/url]﻿, and the technically optional but highly recommended [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip them/paste the requirements but NOT THIS MOD (we will get to that in a later step) into your "Mods" folder.
[/list]
Part Two:[list=1]
[*]Open the "[CP] Farmer Portraits - Nyapu's Style" folder.
[*]Go into the "assets" folder and DELETE the "data" folder. (You may also want to go into the "i18n" folder and delete the "pt" file, as my version of the mod doesn't currently contain a Portuguese translation - if you are playing in Portuguese and run into errors related to translation, then you should do this. You'll unfortunately just have to use this mod in English unless someone offers to make a translation.)
[/list]
Part Three:
[list=1]
[*]Go back out to where you downloaded my mod and cut/copy my "[CP] Farmer Portraits - Nyapu's Style" folder (it is within the zip file you downloaded).
[*]Paste it into your "Mods" folder and a popup should appear - select the option to replace all files.
[/list]
Part Four:
[list=1]
[*]Go into the "[CP] Farmer Portraits - Nyapu's Style" folder that you just replaced the files for.
[*]Open the "content" file in a text editor such as Notepad.
[*]Find (Ctrl + F) "P1Name" (without quotes) and replace all instances with your first player's in-game name.
[*]Find (Ctrl + F) "P2Name" (without quotes) and replace all instances with your second player's in-game name.
[*]Save changes and close the file.
[/list]
Part Five:
[list=1]
[*]Go into the "assets" folder and then into the "data" folder.
[*]Open the first file in a text editor such as Notepad.
[*]Find (Ctrl + F) "P1Name" (without quotes) and replace all instances with your first player's in-game name.
[*]Find (Ctrl + F) "P2Name" (without quotes) and replace all instances with you second player's in-game name.
[*]Save changes and close the file.
[*]Repeat this section's steps 2 through 5 for each file in the "data" folder.
[*]Now you are done installing! Configure the mod to your liking and enjoy!
[/list]

***NOTES***
[list]
[*]Make sure the player names that you put into the json files match the in-game names EXACTLY. As far as I know, they ARE case-sensitive.
[*]Make sure to save backups of your config files, because if I post an update to this mod, then you will need to delete the old folder before installing the updated version to prevent errors. You will also need to repeat the installation steps all over again. But hopefully it will be easier for you the following time(s)!
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/VCFHag8.png[/img][/center]
This mod's configuration options are fairly straightforward, but I have listed the ones that may require explanation below, with the explanations in parenthesis:

[list]
[*]P1 Use Emotions (toggles whether to use "reactions" or to keep the farmer portrait neutral - the "reactions" match the basic emotion portraits of the NPC being spoken to)
[*]P1 Passive Events (passive events include the Desert Festival, Trout Derby, SquidFest, and Night Market)
[*]P1 Location Outfits On Festivals (toggles whether to wear locational outfits on festival days, except at the location that the festival is taking place)
[*]P1 Beach Outfit (toggles whether to wear the Swimsuit Outfit on the beach during summer)
[*]P1 All Day Pajamas (toggles whether to wear pajamas inside the Farmhouse regardless of the time of day)
[*]P1 Outdoor Outfits ("Single" uses one seasonal outfit for all inclement weather conditions (the seasonal Rain outfit), while "All" uses a specific seasonal outfit for each weather condition - Sun, Wind, Rain, Storm, GreenRain (in summer - GreenRain in other seasons will use the Rain outfit), and Snow (in winter - Snow in other seasons will use the regular seasonal outfit))
[*]P1 Indoor Outfits ("Single" uses one seasonal outfit indoors regardless of weather, while "All" uses a specific seasonal outfit for each weather condition - this works similarly to the outdoor outfits
[/list]
All the same configuration options are also available for Player 2 Portraits, just with P2 at the beginning of each setting.

Please see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29697]Jupm's original mod page[/url] for pictures of the various appearance configuration options. The configs relating to these are fairly self-explanatory and shown by the images on that mod's page.

You will also need to configure the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] framework mod itself. Make sure that you configure it to use custom portraits and that you enable all settings in that mod that you want - for example, you may want to ensure that portraits will show up during events and/or situations when you aren't talking to an NPC. For the custom backgrounds option, I just toggle them off and let my UI mods handle that, but you may instead use backgrounds such as those provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23337]Portraited Changing Skies[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6899]Portrait Frame Variations[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16980]Prince's Background Colors[/url], etc. If downloading a background image/images, just make sure to place the background image(s) in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url]﻿ folder with the appropriate names - "background_P1Name" and "background_P2Name" (without quotes and replacing the names with your in-game ones). I have NOT tested this mod with backgrounds enabled, so let me know if you run into any issues. My personal configuration for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] mod is as follows:
"EnableMod": true,
"ShowWithQuestions": true,
"ShowWithEvents": true,
"ShowWithNPCPortrait": true,
"ShowMisc": false,
"FacingFront": false,
"UseCustomPortrait": true,
"UseCustomBackground": false

Also, in Stardew Valley's in-game options menu, I recommend setting each player's UI Scale as low as you can so that there's room in the dialogue boxes for text to appear without it getting completely wonky.

[/list]

***NOTES***
[list]
[*]If you would like me to add compatibility for other mods (weather and/or locational), then just let me know! It's especially helpful if you can provide the correct Weather and/or LocationName tokens I need to add, but no worries if you can't.

[/list]

If you encounter any other issues, please post them in the Bugs section or the comments section with a LINK to your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. Do not post the text from the log or a screenshot from the log. This clogs up the page and makes it difficult for me to understand what's going on and help you. If you post the text or a screenshot from the log rather than a link, then I will tell you to provide a log next time and delete your submission.

The only time you are allowed to submit a report/comment about an issue without a link to your SMAPI log is if for some reason you literally cannot get one (such as it being too large to parse). If that is the case, please say so in your report/comment and provide as much detail about the problem as you can. Under these circumstances, pasting text from/including a screenshot of the log may be helpful.
